story.i-want: comprehensive test coverage with automated CI/CD gates
story.so-that: code quality is maintained and regression bugs are prevented as the codebase scales

criterion.details: - All scripts in scripts/ directory have unit tests - Critical scripts (init-qdrant.py, ingestion scripts, validation scripts) have ≥80% coverage - Test coverage measured via pytest --cov=scripts - Scripts tested in isolation (mocked dependencies)

criterion.description: Overall project coverage ≥40% (currently 22%, target +18 percentage points)
criterion.details: - Coverage increase focused on high-risk modules (ingestion, retrieval, shared) - Backfill tests prioritize business-critical paths - Coverage measured via pytest --cov=raglite --cov=scripts - Coverage report shows module-by-module breakdown

criterion.description: CI/CD coverage gate enforces new code ≥80% (pytest-cov in GitHub Actions)
criterion.details: - GitHub Actions workflow fails if new code coverage <80% - Coverage diff calculated (files changed in PR vs baseline) - PR cannot merge if new code coverage <80% - Coverage gate runs on every PR (not just main branch)

criterion.description: CI/CD coverage ratchet (overall coverage cannot decrease between PRs)
criterion.details: - Ratchet mechanism prevents coverage regression - Overall project coverage tracked in CI artifacts - PR fails if overall coverage decreases (even by 0.1%) - Ratchet enforced on main branch merges

criterion.description: Coverage report displayed in PR comments (GitHub Actions integration)
criterion.details: - Bot comments on PR with coverage summary - Coverage diff highlighted (lines added with/without tests) - Module-level coverage changes shown in table format - Link to detailed HTML coverage report in artifacts

doc.title: Epic 3 Retrospective
doc.section: ACTION ITEM 1: Test Coverage Backfill & CI/CD Gates (lines 150-180)
doc.snippet: CRITICAL finding: Overall project test coverage is 22%, with some modules at 0% coverage (scripts/). Root causes: No coverage gates in CI/CD, no Definition of Done requirement for 80% coverage, focus on acceptance criteria tests but not overall coverage. Strategic solution: 3-tier improvement (Epic 4: 40%, Epic 5: 60%, Production: 80%).

doc.title: Story 3.8: Agentic Workflow Test Suite
doc.snippet: Exemplary test suite with parameterized testing, fixture-based data, shared metrics aggregation, meaningful assertions, CI/CD integration with 30-day artifact retention. Patterns: @pytest.mark.parametrize, TestMetrics class, assert with f-string error messages.

doc.title: Coding Standards
doc.snippet: Type hints required on all functions. Google-style docstrings. pytest 8.4.2 with pytest-asyncio 1.2.0. Structured logging with extra={}. Specific exceptions (no bare except). Async/await for I/O operations. Pydantic models for data structures.

doc.title: Project README

note.title: Epic 3 Retrospective Context (CRITICAL)
note.content:
This story addresses Action Item 1 from Epic 3 Retrospective (2025-11-18), identified as the CRITICAL blocker for Epic 4 quality assurance.
Problem: Overall coverage 22%, scripts/ at 0%. No CI/CD coverage gates. No Definition of Done requirement for 80% coverage.
Root Causes: Focus on acceptance criteria tests (does story work?) but not overall coverage (is every line tested?). No enforcement mechanism.
Strategic Solution: 3-tier approach: 1. Immediate backfill (Epic 4: 40% overall, scripts 60%) 2. CI/CD enforcement (new code ≥80%, ratchet prevents regression) 3. Long-term incremental improvement (Epic 5: 60%, Production: 80%)

note.title: Story 3.8 Testing Patterns (Reference)
note.content:
Story 3.8 marked "EXEMPLARY" by senior developer review. Reuse these patterns:
1. Parameterized testing: @pytest.mark.parametrize reduces duplication 2. Fixture-based data: tests/fixtures/*.json for test scenarios 3. Shared metrics: TestMetrics class aggregates results 4. Meaningful assertions: assert X, f"Message with {variable}" 5. CI/CD integration: GitHub Actions with artifact retention
Files to reference: - tests/integration/test_agentic_workflow_suite.py (389 lines, parameterized tests) - .github/workflows/ci.yml (JOB 8: lines 569-708, CI/CD integration example) - scripts/generate_failure_report.py (256 lines, reporting script pattern)

note.title: Scripts Directory Scope (100+ files)
note.content:
AC1 target: scripts/ ≥60% coverage, critical scripts ≥80%.
Critical scripts (≥80% target): - init-qdrant.py (Qdrant collection initialization) - ingest-*.py (document ingestion scripts) - run-accuracy-tests.py (accuracy validation) - reingest-*.py (re-ingestion workflows)
Testing approach: - Unit tests with mocked dependencies (no real Qdrant/PostgreSQL) - Mock file I/O (use pytest tmp_path fixture) - Parameterize tests for different document types, error scenarios - Focus on business logic, not I/O operations

note.title: Coverage Measurement Commands
note.content:
# Measure overall coverage (AC2) pytest --cov=raglite --cov=scripts --cov-report=html --cov-report=term
# Measure scripts coverage only (AC1) pytest --cov=scripts --cov-report=term
# Generate JSON for CI/CD (AC3-AC5) pytest --cov=raglite --cov=scripts --cov-report=json
# View HTML report open htmlcov/index.html
# Coverage diff calculation (new code only) python scripts/check_coverage_diff.py --baseline=.coverage-baseline.json --current=.coverage.json --threshold=80
# Coverage ratchet check (overall coverage) python scripts/check_coverage_ratchet.py --baseline=.coverage-baseline.json --current=.coverage.json

note.title: CI/CD Workflow Structure (AC3-AC5)
note.content:
Add JOB 9 to .github/workflows/ci.yml:
test-coverage: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: 1. Checkout code 2. Setup Python + dependencies 3. Run pytest --cov (generate .coverage.json) 4. Download baseline coverage (.coverage-baseline.json from main branch artifact) 5. Coverage gate: python scripts/check_coverage_diff.py (fail if new code <80%) 6. Coverage ratchet: python scripts/check_coverage_ratchet.py (fail if overall decreased) 7. Post PR comment: py-cov-action/python-coverage-comment-action@v3 8. Upload coverage report artifact (30-day retention)
PR Comment Format: - Overall coverage: X% (±Y% from baseline) - New code coverage: Z% (≥80% target) - Module-level table (before/after) - Link to HTML report artifact

note.title: Coverage Improvement Roadmap
note.content:
Incremental strategy from Epic 3 Retrospective:
| Epic | Overall Coverage | Increment | New Code | |------|-----------------|-----------|----------| | Epic 3 | 22% | - | ≥80% (new only) | | Epic 4 (this story) | 40% | +18% | ≥80% (enforced) | | Epic 5 | 60% | +20% | ≥80% (enforced) | | Production | 80% | +20% | ≥80% (enforced) |
Backfill priority: - Epic 4: scripts/, ingestion, retrieval, shared → 40% - Epic 5: MCP server, remaining modules → 60% - Production: edge cases, error paths → 80%
Rationale: Incremental improvement across epics, maintaining 80%+ on new code while backfilling existing code.
